0.1: Oh? When did you get here, #h0#? Sorry, I was just thinking...how to grow the company...hm. Don't mind me. Shall we continue?

yes.0: Welcome to your fifteenth acting class. You are going to learn how to make googly eyes today. Of course you know what googly eyes are, so I'll skip the explanation.

no.0: Come now, we can't stop now!
